Kind:
function
Symbol:
GetActivationTime()
Scope:
class ara::exec::DeterministicClient
Syntax:
ara::core::Result<TimeStamp> GetActivationTime () noexcept;
Return value:
ara::core::Result< TimeStamp >
TimeStamp of current activation cycle
Exception Safety:
noexcept
Errors:
ara::exec::ExecErrc::kNoTimeStamp
Time stamp not available
Header file:
#include "ara/exec/deterministic_client.h"
Description:
TimeStamp of activation point.
This method provides the timestamp that represents the point in time when the activation was
triggered by DeterministicClient::WaitForNextActivation() with return value kRun. Subsequent
calls within an activation cycle will always provide the same value. The same value will also be
provided within redundantly executed Processes
